items.why: Volatility spiked as the Nasdaq tumbled into correction territory and the AI trade unwound, with the Dow down 1,800 points.
AMD sank on tighter US chip rules, with Broadcom, CoreWeave and Nebius also dropping on the news.
Nvidia led the AI trade lower for a third straight day, dragging the Nasdaq down more than 2%.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Nasdaq futures down 2.62% after the close, and traders are bracing for Nvidia earnings.
summary: Stocks sold off hard Monday, with the Nasdaq entering correction territory as the AI trade unwound and the Dow down 1,800 points. The S&P 500 fell 1.91% while the VIX surged nearly 20%.
